Special Terms
1. During each consecutive 12 months of the Subscription Term described in this Order, in addition to
CloudShield Enterprise, Customer will be entitled to utilize CloudShield Sensor, up to the Burst Threshold
(defined below) at no additional cost. "Burst Threshold" means the following percentage of the quantity of
CloudShield Enterprise Billable Units purchased by Customer, taking into account any reductions in
CloudShield Enterprise Billable Units due to conversions as described in Section 4 below: (a) during Year 1, up
to 38.89%, (b) during Year 2, up to 28.21%, and (c) during Year 3, up to 19.05%; provided that in no event shall
the Burst Threshold exceed 280,000 Billable Units during any Subscription Year. CloudShield shall have the
right to review Customer's actual Billable Unit usage, and in the event such usage exceeds the Burst Threshold,
CloudShield shall have the right to notify Customer in writing of and provide a true-up order for such excess
usage (a "Workload True-Up"). Following receipt from CloudShield of a Workload True-Up, Customer agrees to
purchase, with respect to the period from the date of the Workload True-Up until the Subscription End Date (the
"True-Up Period"), additional Billable Units in an amount equal to the quantity of Billable Units utilized in excess
of the amount previously purchased by Customer. Notwithstanding Customer's purchase of additional Billable
Units, during the Subscription Term described in this Order, Premium Support shall be capped at fixed rate of
$275,000 per year. During the Subscription Term of this Order, Billable Units shall be calculated according to
Exhibit A.
2. Customer shall receive a free trial of CloudShield Code, up to maximum of 4,000 active developers, for 12
months, commencing on March 1, 2025 and ending on February 28, 2026.
3. During the Subscription Term (specified in this Order), Customer may elect to purchase additional Billable
Units for its CloudShield Enterprise subscriptions at the incremental tiered Billable Unit rates listed below:
CloudShield Enterprise: 1-210,000 cloud workloads - $39/workload/year 210,001-320,000 cloud workloads -
$35/workload/year 320,001+ cloud workloads - $31/workload/year
4. During the Subscription Term of this Order, once per annual term, if requested by Customer, Customer shall
have the right to convert Billable Units of CloudShield Enterprise to Billable Units of CloudShield Code based on
a ratio of 10 CloudShield Enterprise cloud workloads to 1 CloudShield Code active developers. Provided that
upon request for any such conversion, prior to such conversion taking place, the Parties will enter into an
amendment and/or new Order to reflect the revised allocation of Billable Units. For the avoidance of doubt, the
conversion rights set forth herein shall not apply to any additional Billable Units available to Customer under the
Burst Threshold.
5. If Customer elects to extend or renew its CloudShield Enterprise subscription under this Order, during the
first consecutive renewal subscription term (which may be any combination of 12 month term lengths, but shall
not exceed, in the aggregate, a total of 36 months), CloudShield will not increase the applicable monthly/unit
price per Billable Unit for such CloudShield Enterprise subscription by the lesser of (a) five percent (5%) of the
monthly/unit price set forth in this Order, or the (b) the increase, if any, in the CPI (defined below) in effect for
the month that is three months before the Subscription End Date. "CPI" means the Consumer Price Index for All
Urban Consumers (CPI-U), U.S. City Average, All items, not seasonally adjusted, 1982–1984=100 reference
base, published by the United States Department of Labor, Bureau of Labor Statistics.
6. On the first consecutive 36 months renewal, provided that Customer commits to a minimum purchase of
210,000 cloud workloads in the first subscription year, followed by a 5% increase every year of the applicable
